Name: Agile
Ability: Place in either the Close or Ranged combat Rows.

Name: Avenger
Ability: When sent to the Lost pile, a powerful new Unit is summoned to the battlefield.

Name: Berserker
Ability: Transform into a bear when a Mardroeme is on its row.

Name: Bond
Ability: Double the strength (compounding) of Unit(s) with the same name.

Name: Decoy
Ability: Swap with a Unit on the battlefield, returning it to your Hand.

Name: Horn
Ability: Double the strength of all Units in that row (limited to 1 per row).

Name: Mardroeme
Ability: Trigger transformation of all (including future) Berserkers on the same row.

Name: Medic
Ability: Revive one Unit from your Lost pile to the battlefield.

Name: Morale
Ability: Add +1 to all Units in the row (excluding itself).

Name: Muster
Ability: Summon any Units with the same name from your Hand or Draw pile to the battlefield.

Name: Scorch
Ability: Send the highest strength Unit(s) on the battlefield to their respective players Lost pile.

Name: Spy
Ability: Place on an opponent's battlefield (counts towards their total) and Hand up to 2 random Units from your Draw pile.

Name: Weather
Ability: Reduce the strength of all Units in the given Row(s) on the battlefield to 1, including your own.
